summary: Disaster Desk: made the Titan submersible implosion long video (L-20261124-41, 558 s, 79 directed beats) from the owner's first pinned topic. Fact review passed on rewrite 1 and every render gate passed, but QA failed twice, so by the two-round limit it was marked failed and not uploaded. The work is saved for the next run.
why: agents/studio.md section 6 allows two QA rounds. Round 2 still listed 6 picture notes: an overlay over a cause tag, no chapter beats, a boxy parking lot, two flat stretches over 30 s, and two thumbnail wording issues. A video ships only after QA passes.

findings.title: The NTSB final report (MIR-25-36) is out and is the best source
findings.detail: Fetched from ntsb.gov (public domain) and read in full. 30 sourced facts were added to the feed topic 2026-11-20-titan-submersible, each with its source URL, so the next run can use them as they are.

findings.title: The cross-section look's white sheet counts as an empty frame
findings.detail: 44 of 111 stills failed the empty-frame gate until a strong drafting grid was added (96 px, #cddae6). Sent to the improver as backlog item 2026-11-24-cross-section-empty.

findings.title: render.json builds chapters only from 'chapter' scene beats
findings.detail: A video made only of directed beats gets just 'Intro'. The next long video needs a chapter beat at each chapter start.
